blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الكبير ورجاله ثقات الا ان هند بنت الحارث الخثعمية التابعية لم ارمن وثقها ولا جرحها مجمع الزوائد ١٩١/١ طبع مؤسسة المعارف بيروت وهند مقبولة تقريب التهذيب
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ibn Abbas (RA) narrates, “One night in Makkah, the Prophet ﷺ, while standing, said three times, “O Allah,' have I conveyed (the message)?' Hazrat Umar (RA), who had a tender heart, stood up and said, “Yes, (I make Allah witness that you have conveyed it); you greatly encouraged people to embrace Islam. You strove very hard for it. And you gave advice as well.” The Prophet ﷺ said, “Iman will certainly prevail, until Kufr is driven back to its own places. You will certainly travel by sea as well to spread Islam, and certainly very soon a time is going to come when people will learn the Qur'an, and in that time they will recite the Qur'an. And they will say, “We have recited the Qur'an and understood it. Now who is there better than us?' Is there any good in these people?” (There is not an atom's worth of good in them. They claim, who is there better than us.) When the Sahabah asked, “O Rasulullah, who are they?', Rasulullah ﷺ replied, “They are from among you (from this Ummah); they are the fuel of the Fire.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسٍ ﵁ قَالَ: كُنَّا جُلُوساً عِنْدَ بَابِ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ نَتَذَاكَرُ يَنْزِعُ هذَا بِآيَةٍ وَيَنْزِعُ هذَا بِآيَةٍ فَخَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ كَأَنَّمَا يُفْقَأُ فِي وَجْهِهِ حَبُّ الرُّمَّانِ فَقَالَ: يَا هؤُلَاءِ بِهذَا بُعِثْتُمْ أَمْ بِهذَا أُمِرْتُمْ؟ لَا تَرْجِعُوا بَعْدِي كُفَّارًا يَضْرِبُ بَعْضُكُمْ رِقَابَ بَعْضٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الاوسط ورجاله ثقات اثبات مجمع الزوائد:١/ ٣٨٩
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Anas (RA) narrates, “We were sitting at the door of the house of the Prophet ﷺ
